title: Setup › Authentication shows "email and password" on when the deployment declared it off
body:
repo:objectstack#6 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjQkY5yXZrN9BEA3rEK

Filing gate: ① a product defect, found by the os-dev on #34174 (report 7224276022, out-of-scope finding, class a) while fixing PR #38028.

## Facts (main `4af32b99`, measured at `SettingsService.get`; the HTTP route itself was not exercised)

- On a deployment that declares `emailAndPassword.enabled: false` and stores nothing, `auth.email_password_enabled` answers `{ value: true, source: 'default' }` (the manifest default), while `getPublicConfig().emailPassword.enabled` answers `false`.
- So Setup → Settings → Authentication shows the toggle on for a sign-in method that is off. This holds on self-hosted deployments too, not only cloud-managed ones.
- plugin-auth registers no live-status provider for the `auth` namespace, so nothing reconciles the shown value with the running one.

## Expected

The settings page shows the running value of email-and-password sign-in (the deployment's declaration when nothing is stored), or marks the toggle as host-declared.

Seam: spec:`auth.email_password_enabled` (setting default) → renderer: settings page toggle
Dedupe words: email_password_enabled default shown on declared off, auth settings toggle misstates running value, settings live value emailAndPassword declaration
